items.title: Cathie Wood on Nvidia's strengths in a post-Jensen Huang era
items.summary: Cathie Wood of ARK Investments tells Deirdre Bosa that Jensen Huang's exit is a shock but won't stop the AI movement, arguing that a deep bench of engineers sits behind "the Jensen show" and that competition, more than leadership, will decide Nvidia's market share. She walks through how ARK stress-tests Nvidia's share of the GPU market and why people, management and culture now matter more than ever.

items.title: Incoming Texas AG vows rigorous scrutiny of potential SpaceX-Tesla merger - report
items.summary: Investing.com -- Texas Attorney General-elect Nathan Johnson signaled that a potential merger between SpaceX (NASDAQ:SPCX) and Tesla Inc (NASDAQ:TSLA) will face rigorous state-level oversight, introducing new political headwinds for Elon Musk’s corporate consolidation plans. Speaking to Bloomberg on Thursday, the incoming Democratic official warned against excessive corporate concentration as the state’s two most valuable companies advance deal talks.
